notes: { ON | OFF } with ON un-underlined (rendered from the printed page, folio 78), so a bare >>LISTING selects it - which is what 7.3.18.3 GR4/GR5 call 'specifying or implying the ON phrase'. Any other operand is COBOL1911. When a listing is produced the directive turns the listing of the following lines off and on (kb/Work PB5925, Listing2023Tests); with none it has no effect (7.3.18.3 GR1).
